description: The other refusal of the move: not everything inside a parent has an author ORDER. The screen actions of a screen are listed by Studio itself, not by a sequence of the model, so there is no order to change. The message says that and lists the sequences the parent actually has, so the job knows what it can reorder. The clean path (attributes, widgets, input parameters and screen variables) is in tests/jobs/refactor-move.json.
expectError: move: IMobileScreen 'MoveNoOrder' does not keep IScreenAction 'Alfa' in an ordered sequence
